findings.message: STREAMINFO says the stream holds 24000 samples, but its frames hold 15808, 8192 fewer.
The MD5 of the audio in STREAMINFO is 0, which means the encoder did not know it; the audio cannot be checked against it.
The frame at 0x2CEB starts at sample 12288, but the frame before it ends at 4096: 8192 samples are missing.
